draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Bandipur! This national park covers 1,456.3 km2 of Chamarajanagar district and became a tiger reserve under Project Tiger back in 1973.
draft.hungryLine: I don't have food spots for the park itself, so pack snacks and water before you head out.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Bandipur National Park is about a 15 min walk from here.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a quiet spot at the forest edge and just listen to the park.
moodReplies.surprise-me: In February 2019 forest fires burnt about 10,920 acres here in five days and even spread into Mudumalai National Park in Tamil Nadu.

spots.name: Bandipur National Park
spots.detail: 15 min walk · A tiger reserve under Project Tiger

tips.title: Respect the wildlife.
tips.body: This is a tiger reserve, so keep your distance and follow forest rules.

tips.title: Be fire-careful in the dry months.
tips.body: Major forest fires broke out across the park in February 2019, so never drop a lit match or cigarette.

story.title: Tiger reserve
story.body: Bandipur was established as a tiger reserve under Project Tiger in 1973.

story.title: A bigger picture
story.body: The park became part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve in 1986.

story.title: The fires
story.body: In February 2019 fires spread across the park. ISRO estimated about 10,920 acres burnt in five days before the main fire was controlled on 24 February.
